body: Founder: 'gunnr w switch it to consecration just like wow' -> 'same dot cast radius cd.' Was a free toggle self-regen, now a real cast-on-cooldown ground zone at Gunnr's own feet, damaging enemies standing in it. Reuses the existing r_zone infrastructure every other zone hero already shares. DPS/radius/duration/cooldown copied from Ghost's own R zone. Updated ability names/descriptions, AI tags, bot heuristic. Full suite green, build clean.
title: Gunnr W reworked to Consecration (real WoW Paladin ability)
